description: Queensland Regional Profiles is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Queensland Government Statistician's Office. Users can create statistical reports on a range of Queensland community types (e.g. local government areas), produced by the Queensland Government Statistician's Office. These reports are generated automatically using the latest demographic, social and economic data available. Data themes include housing, industry, labour force and education. Community regions can be selected individually, or combined to create customised regions or catchments for profiling. Coverage is the states and territories, 2006 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
